items.title: Surging Oil Prices Singe GE Aerospace
items.summary: Soaring oil prices are hurting shares of once high-flying aviation suppliers, with engine maker GE Aerospace suffering the brunt of the selloff. Its shares were down about 3% midday at $308.50, extending a nearly weeklong slump for the manufacturer.

items.title: What Has To Go Right For GE Stock To Keep Climbing?
items.summary: GE Aerospace (GE) trades near $318, up 13.4% over the past twelve months. Behind that price sits a commercial services backlog of roughly $170 billion, work on engines already flying. The easy read is that the good news is in the price, and the coming three years just work that backlog off. A three-year scenario on the company's own numbers puts a size on what is left.

items.title: Honeywell (HON) Lands Award Winning Marine Barracks Security Rollout
items.summary: Honeywell International (NasdaqGS:HON) has rolled out a centralized access control platform across U.S. Marine Corps barracks under the Barracks 2030 initiative. The deployed system unifies security for global Marine housing facilities and is reported to materially reduce day to day operating costs. The platform has already received industry awards that recognize its impact on military infrastructure security and automation technology. This Marine Corps barracks access control rollout...

items.title: Why Today’s GE Downgrade Wasn’t Just a Downgrade
items.summary: The aerospace business has been a shining light for industrials, but Melius analyst Scott Mikus says the good times may be ending.

items.title: Honeywell Aerospace settles with DOJ for $2M over cybersecurity claims
items.summary: The agency accused the manufacturer of failing to comply with contract requirements that fall under DOD’s Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification program to receive payments.

items.title: Why Is Eaton Priced Above Peers That Earn More Per Sale?
items.summary: Eaton (ETN) grew revenue 15.5% over the past twelve months, faster than any of the five industrial peers it is measured against. It trades at 41.5 times earnings, against roughly 32 times for the next two names in the group. At $409.15 a share as of September 10, 2026, what that premium buys is an operating margin that ranks fourth of six.

items.title: Is Eaton Stock Amplifying A Risk You Already Own?
items.summary: Eaton (ETN) makes the power equipment that goes inside data centers, among much else, and it has climbed 5.0% over the last five trading days while the S&P 500 slipped 0.2%. A run like that pulls money in. The question worth answering is not where the stock goes from here. It is what owning Eaton does to the rest of your money every time the market moves, and it moves further than the index in both directions.
